title: sdks: auth/retries + streaming ergonomics parity + v1.164.0 version bump
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Context: This PR unifies an auth/retry surface across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, fixes several streaming ergonomics gaps, and bumps SDK versions to v1.164.0. Motivation: customers were seeing inconsistent retry behavior for 401/403 transient auth errors across languages, and streaming ergonomics (callbacks vs async iterators) diverged between SDKs. This change harmonizes behavior and improves DX for streaming. What changed (summary): - Standardized auth-retry policy: transient 401/403 now trigger a single token-refresh attempt + exponential backoff before surfacing to callers; non-idempotent requests still respect user retry config. - Streaming parity: introduced async iterator interface in TypeScript that matches Python's async generator ergonomics; added a lightweight helper for Node callback compatibility. Go streaming API now exposes a Reader-like interface and a convenience stream.Iterate helper to match other SDKs. - Surface ergonomics: consistent method names (client.stream, client.stream_iter) and consistent Cancel/Close semantics documented across SDKs. - Tests: added integration tests for auth retry flows and streaming cancellation on all three SDKs. - Docs & changelog: updated quickstarts and SDK changelogs; bumped package versions. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-2345) - [x] Unit tests added/updated - [x] Integration tests for token-refresh and streaming cancel - [x] SDK samples updated - [x] Changelog entry and version bumps - [x] E2E smoke run on staging Notes: - Backcompat: default retry policy is backwards-compatible; users with custom retry configs are unaffected unless they opt into the new default. - Migration: no code changes required for existing call sites; new streaming helpers are additive. - CI: initial run showed a flaky TypeScript streaming test which I fixed by increasing the teardown timeout and adding a deterministic event ordering in the test harness. - Linear: linked ENG-2345 for design and PM-678 for release coordination. Merge: squash-and-merge to keep the SDK release commit clean.

review_comments: Ethan Park: Left a few inline comments about the retry window and max backoff; asked to ensure we don't retry non-idempotent calls by default.
Priya Kapoor (author): Responded — clarified in retryPolicy docs and added an explicit allow_non_idempotent flag; updated tests to cover edge-case.
Monica Li: Noted a race in TS streaming teardown; suggested increasing teardown timeout and adding an ordered event emitter for deterministic test behavior.
Priya Kapoor (author): Fixed the flaky test and added a comment explaining the fix; re-ran CI.
Ravi Patel: Approved after a smoke run on staging and validating changelog entries.
release_notes:
- SDKs: standardize auth retry behavior for transient auth failures (token refresh + backoff)
- Streaming: unified ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; new helpers for iterator/callback interop
- Versions: bump SDK packages to v1.164.0
- Tests: added integration coverage for token refresh and streaming cancellation
